title: Choose My Thumbnail Headline
tests: Tests choosing suitable unspecified headline wording and delivering a complete face-and-text thumbnail without unnecessary clarification.

faults.what: The headline and its dark backing overlap the person's forehead and eye area, obscuring part of the main facial expression.
The supplied image is approximately 1.67:1 rather than the requested 16:9.

judge.summary: The thumbnail has a convincing tired face and a readable, relevant three-word headline, but the text obscures the face and the canvas is not 16:9.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face.
must_haves.why: There is one finished thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking face, but the supplied image is not 16:9.

must_haves.item: A completed headline of exactly three words appears in the image, not placeholder text.
must_haves.why: The headline reads 'STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT,' exactly three words.

must_haves.item: The headline clearly relates to stopping late-night scrolling or improving sleep.
must_haves.why: 'STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT' directly addresses quitting nighttime scrolling.

must_haves.item: The headline is high-contrast and readable at phone-thumbnail size.
must_haves.why: Large white uppercase lettering contrasts strongly against the dark background.

must_haves.item: The face and headline remain unobstructed, with neither cropped awkwardly at the image edges.
must_haves.why: The headline is fully within the frame, but the text and dark backing overlap and obscure the upper face.
